# EZER

> EZER is a subscription tracker app for Android, live on Google Play in the US (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ezersaves.app). It connects to your bank through Plaid (read-only), lists recurring charges, alerts you before renewals and free trials bill, and shows the cancel page and steps for each subscription. Free to download. EZER Premium is $7.99/month after a 7-day free trial. The EZER card with Pay in 4 is coming soon and is waitlist only, not available today.

Built solo by Chiagozie Oliver (Chiagozie LLC dba EZER, Parker, Texas). EZER is a financial technology company, not a bank. The iOS app is in review, not on the App Store yet.

- [Mint alternative](https://ezersaves.com/alternatives/mint/): Mint is gone. Where its features went, and where EZER fits.
- [5 Best Pay in 4 Apps in 2026](https://ezersaves.com/best-pay-in-4-apps-2026/): Late fees, schedule and credit checks compared. EZER is coming soon (waitlist).
- [Subscription tracker app](https://ezersaves.com/subscription-tracker-app/): Free and paid trackers, and which ones need a bank login.
- [How to cancel subscriptions](https://ezersaves.com/how-to-cancel-subscriptions/): Find and cancel every subscription, plus where click to cancel stands.
- [All comparisons](https://ezersaves.com/alternatives/): Hub of EZER comparisons with sourced competitor facts.
